options: Sight alone, with hearing added only in fog
Sight, hearing and all available means
Radar alone whenever radar is fitted and working
The master personally, by sight and hearing
questions.explanation: A look-out is required at all times.

questions.stem: Risk of collision is deemed to exist if:
options: The compass bearing of an approaching vessel does not appreciably change
The approaching vessel is larger, faster or less handy than yours
The approaching vessel has not answered your call on VHF Channel 16
The bearing changes rapidly and the range between you keeps opening
questions.explanation: If in doubt, assume it exists.

questions.stem: Action to avoid collision should be:
options: A series of small alterations so the other vessel is not confused
Delayed until the other vessel has made its intentions clear by VHF
Taken only by the stand-on vessel, once the give-way vessel is close
Positive, in ample time, and large enough to be readily apparent

questions.stem: Two power-driven vessels meeting head-on should each:
options: Alter course to port
Stop and sound five short blasts
Hold course and speed
Alter course to starboard

questions.stem: In a crossing situation the give-way vessel is the one that has the other:
options: Dead astern, overtaking her
On her port side
Abaft her port beam and closing
On her starboard side
The stand-on vessel once she is abeam
Required to stop until signalled
Stand-on if she is the larger vessel
The give-way vessel until finally past

questions.stem: In a narrow channel, which vessels must not impede one that can navigate only inside the channel?
options: Vessels under 20 m, sailing vessels and fishing vessels
Only vessels under 20 m in length, not sailing vessels
Sailing vessels only, as power must give way to sail
Vessels over 100 m or constrained by draught

questions.stem: In a traffic separation scheme, crossing vessels should cross:
options: At any angle she chooses, provided she keeps clear of every vessel in the lane
As nearly as practicable at right angles to the general direction of traffic
At a shallow angle, joining the lane in the same direction as traffic
Along the separation zone until a gap opens in traffic, then straight over

questions.stem: A power-driven vessel keeps out of the way of, among others, a:
options: Vessel engaged in fishing
Larger power vessel
Vessel overtaking her
Pilot vessel on station

questions.stem: In restricted visibility, when a target is detected by radar alone you should avoid:
options: Reducing speed for a vessel forward of the beam
Altering to starboard for a vessel forward of the beam
Altering to port for a vessel forward of the beam
Sounding fog signals while the target is still distant
questions.explanation: Rule 19, with the exception of overtaking.
